entries.0306a02d3a55d0b7: As its teaching philosophy, it sets out "Teach strictly, thinking of them as our own children and our own affairs," "Develop academic ability, energy and physical strength," and "Take responsibility for getting every single student into their first-choice school." In its medium- to long-term management strategy, it states that, with a view to future business expansion across Kyushu, it will enter Okinawa as a new field of challenge and work to enhance and strengthen its management base in its home area of Kagoshima, and it lists strengthening brand power, developing human resources and promoting management efficiency as issues. As issues to be addressed with priority, it lists DX initiatives through the Subaru LMS equipped with AI, the Subaru AI Hissho Navi, live streaming of group classes and Subaru Individual Online, responses to the declining birthrate and declining academic ability, and strengthening of recruitment activities.
